AI 인텔리전스: 2026-10-13 공식 발표로 읽는 산업 변화

공식 기업·기관 발표를 연결해 읽는 AI 산업

AI 인텔리전스 (AI Intelligence) · 2026-10-13

서로 다른 공식 발표를 하나의 산업 흐름으로 묶되, 각 기업이 직접 확인한 사실과 MOTUS의 해석을 분리했다.

From Earth to Orbit, France’s Ecosystem Delivers Agentic Computing at Scale With NVIDIA

Companies in France are deploying agentic computing across industries spanning space, financial services, the public sector and scientific research, demonstrating how the country’s ecosystem has moved from ambition to application. France’s progress sits on deliberate groundwork. The AI Action Summit in February 2025 and Choose France Summits in 2025 and 2026 anchored major compute commitments […]

NVIDIA의 공식 발표가 제품·연구·인프라 변화와 어떻게 연결되는지 확인할 사안이다.

후속 제품 적용, 고객 채택 또는 투자 집행이 실제 성과로 이어지는지가 다음 검증 지점이다.

공식 발표의 시장 의미는 이후 실적과 CAPEX, 고객 채택 자료로 교차 확인해야 한다.

OCP Global Summit: Amid Ecosystem Adoption, NVIDIA Opens Vera Rubin Architecture to Help Scale AI Factories Worldwide

As AI factories grow from megawatts to gigawatts, building them takes more than advanced computing. Open standards are helping the industry scale AI infrastructure faster, more efficiently and more reliably. At the Open Compute Project (OCP) Global Summit, taking place in the San Jose McEnery Convention Center, NVIDIA announced new partnerships and contributions aimed at […]

Microsoft to expand Azure Maia system to multi-gigawatt deployments

Azure Maia 200 now in production; Azure Maia 300 coming in 2027 As we move into the era of Super Intelligence, Microsoft is entering a new phase of infrastructure. We will scale our Azure Maia family to multi-gigawatt deployments starting in 2027, making Maia the primary inference system for Microsoft products and services. The multigenerational... The post Microsoft to expand Azure Maia system to multi-gigawatt deployments appeared first on The Official Microsoft Blog .

기업 AI가 실제 업무로 들어가는 경로
